blocks.text: THE HAGUE, Netherlands — The blockbuster trial of ex-Philippine president Rodrigo Duterte kicks off Monday, the first former Asian leader to be brought before the International Criminal Court. Here are the three key players to watch out for over the coming months — or years: The judge: Joanna Korner Joanna Korner is one of the ICC’s most experienced judges, presiding over more than 500 trials during a career in domestic and international law spanning some 50 years. With a deep, gravelly voice and cut-glass English accent, the 75-year-old commands instant respect with her courtroom statements, often laced with British euphemism and […]...
